16000019.name: PENNY
16000019.intro: Penny is a long-range controller who punishes enemies for standing in a line and uses her cannon to keep important areas unsafe. Her reload is slow, so strong positioning and deliberate shots matter more than constant firing.

attack.name: Plunderbuss
attack.description: Shoots out a pouch of fool's gold. If the pouch hits an enemy, it bursts and coins pepper targets behind the first enemy.

super.name: Old Lobber
super.description: Penny sets up her cannon! It can shoot at enemies at a long range, over cover and setting the ground on fire.

how_to_use: Look for enemies standing behind a teammate, summon, objective, or box; the coin spray is often more dangerous than the first hit.
Keep enough distance to compensate for Penny's slow reload and avoid spending all three ammo slots on low-probability shots.
Place Old Lobber behind a wall on your side of the map so opponents must overextend to remove it.
Use the cannon's landing markers and burning zones to predict dodges, then aim Plunderbuss into the route the enemy is likely to take.
Save Salty Barrel or Master Blaster when assassins can reach you; both can create a valuable defensive interruption.
strengths: Punishes grouped or lined-up enemies
Long-range objective and lane control
Cannon attacks safely over walls
Burning zones restrict escape paths
watch_out_for: Slow reload makes missed shots costly
Single targets reduce coin-spray value
Cannonballs are easier to dodge in open space
Aggressive divers can punish poor barrel timing

gadgets.name: SALTY BARREL
gadgets.description: Penny drops a barrel of salt that blocks enemy projectiles. She can also use it to burst her own gold pouches. Cooldown: 18 seconds.

gadgets.name: TRUSTY SPYGLASS
gadgets.description: Penny's cannon blasts at every visible enemy position within range. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

star_powers.name: HEAVY COFFERS
star_powers.description: Penny's gold pouches burst with a 100% wider cone after each hit.

star_powers.name: MASTER BLASTER
star_powers.description: Penny's cannon deals 1372 damage and knocks back nearby enemies on landing.

hypercharge.name: NEW LOBBER
hypercharge.description: Penny deploys a bigger cannon that shoots 2 cannonballs at a time instead of 1

recommended_build.note: A safe general-purpose setup: Salty Barrel and Master Blaster cover Penny's vulnerability to close pressure. Swap to Heavy Coffers when enemies are likely to group.

16000017.name: TARA
16000017.intro: Tara is a piercing damage dealer whose three-card attack chips reliably at range and becomes much stronger up close. Her match-changing Gravity Super groups enemies for a burst, interrupts positioning, and can open walls.

attack.name: Triple Tarot
attack.description: Tara flicks her wrist, snapping off three tarot cards that pierce through enemies. Quite a trick!

super.name: Gravity
super.description: Tara conjures up a mind-boggling gravity well! Enemies in the area of effect get pulled in, crashing together painfully hard.

how_to_use: Use one- or two-card hits to build Super safely; do not force close range before you have an advantage.
Keep ammo ready before throwing Gravity so the grouped enemies can be hit by an immediate full volley.
Target two or more enemies when possible, especially after they cluster near an objective or at the start of a Brawl Ball round.
Throw Gravity behind a pursuing enemy to pull them away from you, or into escape cover to break the wall and expose the route.
Protect Healing Shade behind cover; choose Black Portal when scouting and extra offensive pressure are more valuable than sustain.
strengths: Piercing cards pressure grouped targets
Gravity can set up team-wide combos
High close-range burst when all cards connect
Super can disrupt positioning and break cover
watch_out_for: Slow reload punishes wasted volleys
Moderately low health limits direct duels
Super takes patience to charge
Summoned shadows can be cleared quickly

gadgets.name: PSYCHIC ENHANCER
gadgets.description: Tara and her allies are able to see all enemies, even inside bushes, for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

gadgets.name: SUPPORT FROM BEYOND
gadgets.description: Tara surrounds herself with three weak shadows that attack enemies and disappear after 6 seconds. Cooldown: 17 seconds.

star_powers.name: BLACK PORTAL
star_powers.description: Tara's Super cracks open a dimensional portal! A shadowy version of Tara appears and attacks her enemies.

star_powers.name: HEALING SHADE
star_powers.description: Tara's Super cracks open a dimensional portal! A shadowy version of Tara appears to heal Tara and her teammates.

hypercharge.name: SUPERMASSIVE
hypercharge.description: Gravity has 20% larger area.

recommended_build.note: A balanced control setup for coordinated modes. Use Support From Beyond for disposable pressure or Heist, and Black Portal when offense and scouting matter more than healing.

16000020.name: FRANK
16000020.intro: Frank is a very high-health tank whose piercing hammer swings become faster as his health falls. Both his attack and Super have a wind-up, so he succeeds by reading enemy control abilities and choosing moments when opponents cannot interrupt him.

attack.name: Hammer Hit
attack.description: Frank takes a while to wind up his hammer blow, but the hit is so hard it sends a shockwave. His attack speed goes up when his health goes down.

super.name: Stunning Blow
super.description: Frank's greatest hit sends a shockwave that destroys environment and stuns enemies for a while.

how_to_use: Use walls and bushes to enter attack range without absorbing unnecessary long-range damage.
Track enemy knockbacks, pulls, and stuns; commit to Stunning Blow after those interrupts are unavailable.
Angle the Super to catch multiple enemies, but avoid breaking useful friendly cover too early.
Use Frank's health as objective pressure, then retreat before the enemy can finish the damage cycle.
Pair with pull or grouping effects so the delayed shockwaves become much harder to dodge.
strengths: Largest health pool and strong objective presence
Piercing attacks punish grouped enemies
Super can stun a full team and open walls
Attack speed rises as health falls
watch_out_for: Wind-ups are vulnerable to crowd control
Cannot move while attacking
Open maps expose his limited reach
Poorly timed wall breaks may help enemy marksmen

gadgets.name: ACTIVE NOISE CANCELING
gadgets.description: Fires a soundwave in a target direction, dealing 1200 damage to Brawlers. Frank becomes immune to Crowd Control for 3.5 secs. Cooldown: 16 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Soundwave also destroys enemy projectiles.

gadgets.name: IRRESISTIBLE ATTRACTION
gadgets.description: Frank aims a long-range attack that pulls enemies torwards him. Consumes ammo. Does 2480 damage. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Enemies are slowed for 2 sec when hit.

star_powers.name: POWER GRAB
star_powers.description: Frank steals the power of a Brawler he defeats, increasing his damage by 15% for 12 seconds!
star_powers.buffie_description: Defeating a Brawler increases attack damage by 15% for 12 secs. Heal for 4480 health over 3 secs.

star_powers.name: SPONGE
star_powers.description: Frank gains +1360 health.
star_powers.buffie_description: Take 10% less damage when above 50% health.

hypercharge.name: SEISMIC SMASH
hypercharge.description: Frank's Super now hits an entire circle around him!
hypercharge.buffie_description: Main attack speed is increased to max while Frank is Hypercharged!

recommended_build.note: A proactive general build that protects Frank's wind-up and rewards confirmed eliminations. Use Sponge when reliable durability matters more than snowball damage.

16000021.name: GENE
16000021.intro: Gene is a controller with reliable long-range chip, team healing options, and one of the game's strongest pick tools. His split attack checks bushes and blocks healing; Magic Hand can turn one exposed enemy into an immediate numbers advantage.

attack.name: Smoke Blast
attack.description: Gene shoots a solid ball of magical smoke from his lamp. If the ball doesn't hit a target, it splits up and spreads the damage in a cone.

super.name: Magic Hand
super.description: Gene launches a magical hand from his lamp. If the hand hits an enemy, they get pulled back to Gene's location!

how_to_use: Aim slightly beside distant enemies when chip or bush scouting is more important than the main projectile.
Save ammo before a pull so Gene and his team can immediately burst the captured target.
Prioritize gem carriers, bounty leaders, and fragile damage dealers rather than tanks that benefit from being pulled closer.
Stand near teammates when using Magic Puffs, but avoid clustering tightly enough for enemy area damage.
Keep Lamp Blowout available when a missed or risky pull could place an assassin beside you.
strengths: Very long and wide chip coverage
Magic Hand creates decisive picks
Can heal nearby teammates continuously
Good scouting and healing interruption
watch_out_for: Slow reload limits burst after wasted shots
A bad pull can help an enemy tank
Super requires clear aim and patience
Moderate solo damage without team follow-up

gadgets.name: LAMP BLOWOUT
gadgets.description: All enemies close to Gene are instantly pushed back. If at least one enemy Brawler is within range, Gene will also restore 10% of his max health. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

gadgets.name: VENGEFUL SPIRITS
gadgets.description: Gene shoots a homing missile at all visible enemies within a large area, dealing up to 1600 damage based on distance. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

star_powers.name: MAGIC PUFFS
star_powers.description: Gene heals all friendly Brawlers around him for 608 health per second.

star_powers.name: SPIRIT SLAP
star_powers.description: Gene's Magic Hand also damages enemies, dealing 2000 damage on hit.

hypercharge.name: HYPER HANDS
hypercharge.description: Gene's Super splits into 3 different hands, each being able to grab one enemy. First goes straight, and the other 2 go diagonally.

recommended_build.note: A safe team-control setup with escape, healing, longer pull reach, and scouting. Spirit Slap is better when Gene must create picks without much teammate burst.

16000022.name: TICK
16000022.intro: Tick is a long-range artillery controller with extremely low health and slow reload. His mines deny routes from behind cover, while Headfirst provides finishing pressure and a valuable knockback against enemies who reach him.

attack.name: Minimines
attack.description: Tick lobs a cluster of mines that separate before landing. The mines explode on contact with a target, or after a few seconds.

super.name: Headfirst
super.description: Tick detaches and launches his head. After landing, the head hops toward the nearest target and explodes on contact!

how_to_use: Play behind walls and teammates; Tick should control the fight without standing on the objective himself.
Spread attacks across exits and choke points instead of stacking every mine in one location.
Keep one ammo available when assassins can engage so their landing or retreat path is covered.
Use Headfirst to finish weak enemies, reveal a nearby bush, or force a close-range attacker to back away.
Rotate between cover after firing so enemy marksmen cannot pre-aim your next position.
strengths: Excellent long-range area denial
Attacks safely over walls
Headfirst pressures weak or hidden enemies
Strong knockback-based self-defense
watch_out_for: Extremely low health
Very slow reload
Struggles to occupy open objectives
Divers can punish missing Super or Gadget

gadgets.name: MINE MANIA
gadgets.description: Tick's next attack fires 6 mines. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

gadgets.name: LAST HURRAH
gadgets.description: Tick gains a 50% shield for 1 seconds. After that, it bursts out for 1360 damage. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

star_powers.name: WELL OILED
star_powers.description: When Tick takes no damage and doesn't attack, he starts recovering health 2 seconds faster than normal.

star_powers.name: AUTOMA-TICK RELOAD
star_powers.description: Tick's reload time is 9% shorter.

hypercharge.name: HEADSTRONG
hypercharge.description: Tick quickly deploys his head, charging enemies faster and leaving behind 6 of his minimines on explosion.

recommended_build.note: A survival-focused setup for most matches. Choose Mine Mania and Automa-Tick Reload when safe positioning lets Tick maximize pure area pressure.

16000023.name: LEON
16000023.intro: Leon is a fast assassin whose four blades deal much more damage at close range. Smoke Bomb lets him reposition unseen, escape a losing fight, or approach a vulnerable target from an unexpected angle.

attack.name: Spinner Blades
attack.description: Leon flicks his wrist and fires four Spinner Blades. The blades deal less damage the farther they travel.

super.name: Smoke Bomb
super.description: Leon becomes invisible for 6 seconds. If he attacks, he will be revealed. Enemies close to Leon will be able to spot him.

how_to_use: Chip at long range until Smoke Bomb is ready, then use invisibility to change lanes or create an off-angle.
Approach from a route that avoids predictable splash damage and the four-tile detection radius.
Choose isolated or low-health targets; a full-health tank can survive the opening and punish Leon's reload.
Keep one ammo after the first close volley so you can finish the target or force an escape.
Use invisibility defensively when carrying an objective or when staying alive is worth more than one elimination.
strengths: High close-range burst
Very fast movement and flexible flanks
Invisibility creates ambush and escape options
Long range can safely build Super
watch_out_for: Damage falls sharply with distance
Area attacks can reveal or predict his path
Limited value when enemies stay grouped
Failed ambushes expose his reload window

gadgets.name: CLONE PROJECTOR
gadgets.description: Leon creates an illusion of himself to confuse his enemies. The clone attacks enemies dealing minor damage. Cooldown: 13 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Leon can reactivate the Gadget, while a clone is active, to swap positions with the clone!

gadgets.name: LOLLIPOP DROP
gadgets.description: Leon creates a stealthy area for his team to hide in. The lollipop slowly loses its health over time. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Leon and teammates gain +15% movement speed inside the area.

star_powers.name: SMOKE TRAILS
star_powers.description: When Leon is not visible, he gains a 30% movement speed for the duration of his invisibility.
star_powers.buffie_description: Projectiles deal +15% damage for 0.5 seconds after breaking invisibility.

star_powers.name: INVISIHEAL
star_powers.description: Leon recovers 1320 health per second while his Super is active.
star_powers.buffie_description: Leon's Super duration is +1 sec longer.

hypercharge.name: LIMBO
hypercharge.description: Leon stays invisible while attacking his enemies.
hypercharge.buffie_description: Leon's main attacks do at least 75% damage regardless of distance.

recommended_build.note: A flexible team and survival setup. Clone Projector and Smoke Trails are stronger when scouting and rapid rotations matter more than sustained invisibility.

16000024.name: ROSA
16000024.intro: Rosa is a fast close-range tank who uses bushes and a powerful damage-reduction Super to hold space. She needs cover to enter punching range, but once connected she combines very fast reload with strong sustained pressure.

attack.name: Hands of Stone
attack.description: Rosa throws a flurry of powerful punches with perfect technique!

super.name: Strong Stuff
super.description: Rosa gets a second skin of tough vine for 4 seconds, decreasing all damage received by 70% for the duration.

how_to_use: Move between bushes and walls so ranged enemies cannot weaken Rosa before she reaches punching distance.
Activate Strong Stuff just before the enemy commits damage, then use the shield time to take ground or force a retreat.
Use Grow Light to create a lasting approach route or protect an important lane from open sightlines.
Save Unfriendly Bushes for hidden enemies or to slow a target before crossing the final distance.
Do not chase too far after the shield expires; reset behind cover and build the next engagement.
strengths: High health and very strong temporary shielding
Fast reload and sustained close damage
Bush creation and bush control
Excellent objective and ball pressure
watch_out_for: Very short attack range
Knockbacks and stuns waste shield time
Open maps provide few safe approaches
Slow attack unload can lose quick burst races

gadgets.name: GROW LIGHT
gadgets.description: Rosa fertilizes the ground around her and bushes instantly grow to provide great cover. Cooldown: 13 seconds.

gadgets.name: UNFRIENDLY BUSHES
gadgets.description: All opponents hiding in bushes take 300 damage and get slowed down for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 14 seconds.

star_powers.name: PLANT LIFE
star_powers.description: Rosa recovers 432 health per second when inside a bush.

star_powers.name: THORNY GLOVES
star_powers.description: Rosa's punches gain +300 damage during her Super.

hypercharge.name: GRASPING ROOTS
hypercharge.description: Rosa slows down all nearby enemies while her Super is active.

recommended_build.note: A bush-control setup that improves approach and sustain. Use Unfriendly Bushes on existing bush-heavy maps and Thorny Gloves when direct shield pushes decide fights.

16000025.name: CARL
16000025.intro: Carl is a durable damage dealer with one returning pickaxe instead of a normal ammo cycle. Walls shorten its travel time for faster repeated hits, while Tailspin and Flying Hook give him unusual mobility and finishing power.

attack.name: Pickaxe
attack.description: Carl throws his Pickaxe like a boomerang. After he catches the returning Pickaxe, he can throw it again.

super.name: Tailspin
super.description: Carl goes into a crazy spin for a few seconds, flailing around and damaging nearby opponents.

how_to_use: Aim so the outgoing and returning pickaxe cross the enemy, doubling pressure from one throw.
Throw beside a wall when possible; the early return shortens Carl's effective reload cycle.
Use Flying Hook for a confirmed angle, objective rotation, or escape rather than an unsupported blind dive.
Wait for knockbacks and stuns to be spent before using Tailspin near multiple enemies.
Curve Carl's movement during the return path to change the pickaxe line and catch a dodging target.
strengths: Strong health and long-range pressure
One attack can hit twice and pierce
Excellent mobility with Gadget and Super
Walls can increase attack frequency
watch_out_for: No attack until the pickaxe returns
Tailspin is vulnerable to interruption
Poor dives leave him surrounded
Open angles make return hits easier to avoid

gadgets.name: HEAT EJECTOR
gadgets.description: The next pickaxe Carl throws will drop a trail of hot rocks behind it! Opponents that touch them are set on fire, and receive 600 damage per second. Cooldown: 17 seconds.

gadgets.name: FLYING HOOK
gadgets.description: Carl's next attack makes his pickaxe pull him to the farthest point of the attack. Cooldown: 19 seconds.

star_powers.name: POWER THROW
star_powers.description: Carl throws his Pickaxe with 10% more speed, allowing it to travel faster and return faster.

star_powers.name: PROTECTIVE PIROUETTE
star_powers.description: During Carl's Super, all damage he receives is reduced by 35%.

hypercharge.name: FLAMESPIN
hypercharge.description: Carl gains a flame trail while using his Super. The trail burns on contact, causing damage over time.

recommended_build.note: A flexible engage-and-survive setup. Power Throw is preferable when most of the match will be played at range rather than through Tailspin dives.

16000026.name: BIBI
16000026.intro: Bibi is a very fast close-range tank with a wide bat swing and a charged Home Run knockback. She controls space around the ball and walls, while her bouncing bubble can pierce and hit the same target multiple times.

attack.name: Three Strikes
attack.description: Bibi swings her baseball bat. Once her Home Run bar is fully charged, her next swing will knock back enemies!

super.name: Spitball
super.description: Bibi bats a bouncing ball of bubble gum that can go through enemies, and even hit the same target multiple times!

how_to_use: Keep the Home Run bar charged while approaching so enemies must respect the knockback.
Use the bat's wide arc around wall corners where opponents cannot easily return fire.
In Brawl Ball, preserve the charged swing when defense or ball recovery matters more than immediate damage.
Aim Spitball along walls and narrow lanes to create repeat hits instead of sending it into empty open space.
Use Bibi's speed to pressure and retreat; do not remain in range after spending the knockback and all ammo.
strengths: Very fast movement and reload
Wide attack with powerful knockback
High health and strong objective pressure
Bubble can pierce, bounce, and multi-hit
watch_out_for: Short range and attack wind-up
Knockback can accidentally save an enemy
Control effects stop aggressive pushes
Open maps limit safe approaches and bubble bounces

gadgets.name: VITAMIN BOOSTER
gadgets.description: Bibi heals 1000 health per second for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Instantly charges Bibi's Home run bar and her next attack restores 50% damage as health.

gadgets.name: EXTRA STICKY
gadgets.description: Bibi throws bubble gum that slows all enemies in it by 20%. Cooldown: 21 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: The slowing effect increases the longer the gum stays on the ground.

star_powers.name: HOME RUN
star_powers.description: Bibi's movement speed is increased by 12% when her Home Run bar is fully charged.
star_powers.buffie_description: Home Run attack deals +15% damage.

star_powers.name: BATTING STANCE
star_powers.description: When Bibi's Homerun bar is fully charged, she shields herself from all damage by 20%.
star_powers.buffie_description: Bibi gains a shield for 5 seconds when her Super hits an enemy Brawler.

hypercharge.name: OUT OF BOUNDS
hypercharge.description: Bibi's bouncing ball splits when hitting an enemy.
hypercharge.buffie_description: Hypercharged main attack has a shorter wind-up time.

recommended_build.note: A durable close-range setup. Home Run is the alternative when faster rotations and reaching targets matter more than the defensive shield.

16000027.name: 8-BIT
16000027.intro: 8-Bit is a slow but durable long-range damage dealer with excellent burst and team amplification. He wins through careful positioning, accurate six-beam volleys, and a protected Damage Booster that turns a controlled area into his team's strongest ground.

attack.name: Blaster Beams
attack.description: Shoots a burst of Blaster Beams that damage any opponent they hit. The beams have a slight spread.

super.name: Damage Booster
super.description: Deploys a turret that increases the damage output of all friendly Brawlers in its area of effect.

how_to_use: Pre-aim and track movement through the six-beam burst; small corrections keep more beams connected.
Use walls to compensate for 8-Bit's slow movement and avoid crossing large open areas without support.
Place Damage Booster behind safe cover but close enough that teammates can contest the objective from its radius.
Keep Cheat Cartridge available as an escape or rapid return to the Booster when flankers approach.
Do not chase outside the boosted zone unless an elimination is certain; 8-Bit's strength is controlled ground, not pursuit.
strengths: Very high long-range burst
High health for a ranged damage dealer
Booster amplifies the whole team
Very fast reload supports sustained pressure
watch_out_for: Slowest base movement speed
Burst requires accurate tracking
Flanks can isolate him from the Booster
Poor turret placement gives away Super value

gadgets.name: CHEAT CARTRIDGE
gadgets.description: 8-Bit instantly teleports to his Damage Booster. Cooldown: 18 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Heals himself for 3600, and repairs the booster by 100%.

gadgets.name: EXTRA CREDITS
gadgets.description: 8-Bit fires 18 projectiles. Consumes ammo. Cooldown: 18 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: These projectiles bounce to nearby enemies.

star_powers.name: BOOSTED BOOSTER
star_powers.description: Increases the Damage Booster's range by 50% and boosts damage by an additional 15%.
star_powers.buffie_description: Every 5 sec, the Damage Booster spawns an ammo clip lasting 8 sec and reloading 1 ammo.

star_powers.name: PLUGGED IN
star_powers.description: While near the Damage Booster, 8-Bit gains +25% Movement Speed.
star_powers.buffie_description: Teammates get a 10% Speed Boost.

hypercharge.name: AIMBOT
hypercharge.description: 8-Bit's turret now has a laser that shoot nearby enemies. Shots do 230 damage.
hypercharge.buffie_description: During Hypercharge, 8-Bit gains infinite ammo and can interrupt his current Main Attack with another one.

recommended_build.note: A general team-control setup that protects positioning and maximizes the Booster. Plugged In is valuable when personal mobility is the main weakness on the selected map.

16000028.name: SANDY
16000028.intro: Sandy is a fast team controller with a wide piercing attack and a large nine-second Sandstorm. The Super conceals allies, changes how enemies can approach an objective, and becomes healing, damaging, or weakening territory through loadout choices.

attack.name: Pebble Blast
attack.description: Sandy pelts enemies with sharp, piercing pebbles. Ouch!

super.name: Sandstorm
super.description: Sandy summons a sandstorm that lasts for 9 seconds and hides friendly Brawlers inside it.

how_to_use: Use the wide piercing attack to pressure two enemies or reveal a bush without overexposing Sandy.
Place Sandstorm across the objective and nearby approach routes so allies can change lanes unseen.
Enter and leave the storm at different points; predictable exits remove most of the concealment advantage.
Use Sweet Dreams to interrupt an important action, then coordinate damage after the brief sleep begins.
Choose Healing Winds for sustained team holds and Rude Sands when revealing and displacing enemies is more valuable.
strengths: Large team-wide concealment field
Wide piercing attack is easy to apply
Strong objective control and rotations
Loadout can add healing, damage, or weakening
watch_out_for: Moderate damage and reload limit solo burst
Enemies can see allies from close range
Carrying objectives can reveal movement
Poor storm placement offers little team access

gadgets.name: SLEEP STIMULATOR
gadgets.description: Sandy falls asleep for 1.5 seconds and his health is fully restored. Cooldown: 11 seconds.

gadgets.name: SWEET DREAMS
gadgets.description: Sandy's next attack lulls opponents to sleep for 1 second. They will however wake up from any damage. Cooldown: 18 seconds.

star_powers.name: RUDE SANDS
star_powers.description: Sandstorm now also damages enemies for 216 damage per second.

star_powers.name: HEALING WINDS
star_powers.description: Sandstorm now also heals friendly Brawlers for 410 health per second.

hypercharge.name: SWIFT WINDS
hypercharge.description: Sandy grants himself and his allies 20% increased movement speed while inside of Sandstorm. His Super will also silence enemies for 0.5 seconds when it lands.

recommended_build.note: A team-control setup with interruption, sustain, and reduced enemy damage inside the storm. Rude Sands is better when revealing enemies and preventing healing matters more.

16000029.name: BEA
16000029.intro: Bea is a one-ammo marksman who alternates between a regular hit and a much stronger Supercharged shot. Her long range and slowing swarm punish predictable movement, but low health makes positioning and accuracy essential.

attack.name: Big Sting
attack.description: Bea sends out a long range shot that, upon landing, Supercharges her next shot to deal epic damage!

super.name: Iron Hive
super.description: Bea deploys a swarm of drones that move and turn like jets. They slow down any opponents caught in their path.

how_to_use: Land the normal shot on the safest available target, then protect the Supercharged shot for a high-value enemy.
Aim slightly ahead of movement at maximum range; Bea cannot cover a miss with another stored ammo slot.
Use Iron Hive before the empowered shot so the slow makes the important projectile easier to land.
Place Honey Molasses behind cover or in a choke point where opponents must spend time removing it.
Maintain long sightlines and retreat early from assassins; Bea's low health leaves little room for a late reaction.
strengths: Very long range and huge empowered damage
Fast one-shot reload cycle
Super creates reliable slow coverage
Strong against predictable or high-health targets
watch_out_for: Low health and weak close defense
Only one ammo slot
Missing Supercharged shots loses major pressure
Walls and fast dives reduce her sightline advantage

gadgets.name: HONEY MOLASSES
gadgets.description: Bea drops a beehive with a splash of sticky honey around it. The honey slows down enemies that step in it. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

gadgets.name: RATTLED HIVE
gadgets.description: Bea unleashes 4 angry bees that circle away from her, dealing more damage the further they go (up to 1200 damage). Cooldown: 24 seconds.

star_powers.name: INSTA BEALOAD
star_powers.description: Instantly Supercharge Bea's Big Sting one time if she misses a Supercharged shot.

star_powers.name: HONEYCOMB
star_powers.description: Bea receives a 30% shield while Big Sting is Supercharged.

hypercharge.name: PROTECT THE QUEEN
hypercharge.description: Bea's Super projectiles split into 2 when at max distance (and on hit), increasing her Super's distance and spread even more.

recommended_build.note: A forgiving long-range setup with choke control and a second empowered-shot chance. Honeycomb is preferable when surviving poke while holding the charged shot is the priority.

16000029.source_note: Ability and Buffy text was checked against the current Brawl Stars Wiki; Gear progression and Buffy rules were cross-checked with Supercell. Verified 2026-08-31.

16000030.name: EMZ
16000030.intro: EMZ is a mid-range controller whose lingering spray deals the most damage when enemies remain in its middle. She dominates approaches and objectives with repeated damage zones, but enemies already beside her can slip inside the attack's strongest area.

attack.name: Spray
attack.description: Emz gives you a blast of her hair spray! It's strong enough to melt your face.

super.name: Caustic Charisma
super.description: Emz creates a cloud of toxicity around herself, slowing down the movement of enemies and damaging them.

how_to_use: Keep enemies in the middle of Spray instead of walking directly into point-blank range.
Layer attacks across escape routes so opponents must cross a second lingering cloud.
Use Caustic Charisma when enemies commit to an objective or need to pass a narrow approach.
Save Friendzoner for assassins and tanks that reach the weak inner area of Spray.
Avoid emptying all ammo at once; EMZ's slow reload makes one reserved cloud valuable for control.
strengths: High multi-tick damage at ideal spacing
Wide piercing lane pressure
Super slows and controls a moving area
Strong against grouped objective pushes
watch_out_for: Weak damage at point-blank range
Slow reload after missed sprays
Long-range marksmen can stay outside control
Divers punish missing Friendzoner

gadgets.name: FRIENDZONER
gadgets.description: Emz fires off some hairspray that pushes enemies back. Deals 500 damage. Cooldown: 19 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Knocks enemies back farther and stuns them for 1 sec if knocked into a wall.

gadgets.name: ACID SPRAY
gadgets.description: Emz squirts out hairspray that goes through walls! Deals 1120 damage. Cooldown: 16 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Slows enemies on hit.

star_powers.name: BAD KARMA
star_powers.description: Enemies that stay within the cloud of Emz's toxic hair spray suffer increasing damage, 25% per hit.
star_powers.buffie_description: Reduce damage dealt by enemies hit by Emz's main attack by 15% for 4 sec.

star_powers.name: HYPE
star_powers.description: Emz recovers 624 health per second for each enemy Brawler inside her Super's area of effect.
star_powers.buffie_description: Emz takes no damage for 0.5 sec when activating her Super.

hypercharge.name: OVERHYPED HAZE
hypercharge.description: Emz pushes enemies to the outer edge of her Super on activation and follows up with a dose of her spray.
hypercharge.buffie_description: Sprays will poison enemies!

recommended_build.note: A safe control build with anti-dive protection and sustain. Bad Karma is stronger when opponents must remain in predictable lanes.

16000030.source_note: Ability and Buffy text was checked against the current Brawl Stars Wiki; Gear progression and Buffy rules were cross-checked with Supercell. Verified 2026-08-31.

16000031.name: MR. P
16000031.intro: Mr. P is a long-range controller whose bouncing suitcases threaten enemies behind cover. His porter base creates a steady stream of distractions that reveal positions, consume enemy ammo, and make passive lanes increasingly difficult to hold.

attack.name: Your Suitcase Sir!
attack.description: Mr. P throws a heavy suitcase with angry intent. If the suitcase hits an obstacle or reaching maximum range, it bounces over them, lands with a bang and deals area damage.

super.name: Porters! Attack!
super.description: Mr. P deploys the home base for his robo-porters. He has reprogrammed the small penguin-head robots to attack and harass opponents (and unruly guests).

how_to_use: Aim so the suitcase lands behind cover after the bounce rather than stopping at the wall.
Place the home base where long-range enemies cannot remove it without abandoning their lane.
Push immediately after a porter absorbs enemy ammo or reveals a hidden target.
Use Porter Reinforcements before an important engagement to create pressure without waiting for Super.
Do not place the base too far back; porters that spend the whole fight walking create little value.
strengths: Bounced attacks pressure behind cover
Porters scout and consume enemy ammo
Very long effective range
Persistent Super value if the base survives
watch_out_for: Moderate direct damage
Area attacks remove porters efficiently
Exposed home bases disappear quickly
Aggressive divers can bypass porter pressure

gadgets.name: SERVICE BELL
gadgets.description: Mr. P buffs his current porter by increasing its damage by 228 and health by 1480. Cooldown: 17 seconds.

gadgets.name: PORTER REINFORCEMENTS
gadgets.description: The next attack will spawn a weak porter where the attack lands. Cooldown: 17 seconds.

star_powers.name: HANDLE WITH CARE
star_powers.description: Every 4 seconds, the explosion damage of Mr. P's next overstuffed suitcase is increased by 40%.

star_powers.name: REVOLVING DOOR
star_powers.description: All robo-porters from the home base now have 20% more health and 30% higher damage.

hypercharge.name: SUPER PORTERS! ASSEMBLE!
hypercharge.description: Mr. P's home base now spawns much stronger porters and he can have two active 'Super Porters' at the same time.

recommended_build.note: A consistent porter-pressure setup. Handle With Care is preferable on maps where long-range bounce damage matters more than keeping porters alive.

16000031.source_note: Ability and Buffy text was checked against the current Brawl Stars Wiki; Gear progression and Buffy rules were cross-checked with Supercell. Verified 2026-08-31.

16000032.name: MAX
16000032.intro: Max is a very fast support with four ammo slots, rapid reload, and a team movement-speed Super. She creates tempo by constantly firing while moving and choosing the moment when her whole team can overwhelm an angle together.

attack.name: Faster Blaster
attack.description: Max's blaster shoots a bunch of projectiles fast! It holds a lot of rounds, and Max is quick with the reload.

super.name: Let's Go!
super.description: Max momentarily boosts up her movement speed and that of nearby allies. Gotta go fast!

how_to_use: Strafe continuously while firing so Max builds passive Super and remains difficult to predict.
Use four ammo slots for sustained lane pressure, but preserve enough ammunition for the speed-boost push.
Group briefly before Let's Go! so multiple teammates receive the same tempo advantage.
Use Phase Shifter through a predictable burst or finishing shot, not simply for distance.
Exploit speed to change lanes and create a temporary numbers advantage before opponents rotate.
strengths: Exceptional personal and team mobility
Four ammo slots and fast reload
Strong sustained pressure while moving
Super enables coordinated engages and escapes
watch_out_for: Burst requires several projectiles to connect
Speed offers little if teammates cannot follow
Low single-shot damage
Overaggressive dashes can isolate Max

gadgets.name: PHASE SHIFTER
gadgets.description: Max dashes forward, and becomes immune to all damage from enemies while dashing. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Max can dash a second time 2 sec after the first dash.

gadgets.name: SNEAKY SNEAKERS
gadgets.description: Max throws a lightning bolt. If she reactivates her gadget, or after 3 seconds, she blinks back to the lightning bolt and heals any damage taken since. Cooldown: 15 seconds
gadgets.buffie_description: When blinking back, Max fully refills her ammo and heals teammates near the lightning bolt for the same amount that she healed.

star_powers.name: SUPER CHARGED
star_powers.description: Hitting an enemy with Max’s Main Attack extends the duration of her Super by 0.25 seconds.
star_powers.buffie_description: Teammates affected by Max's Super gain a shield for 4 sec.

star_powers.name: RUN N GUN
star_powers.description: Max reloads faster while moving.
star_powers.buffie_description: Max gains a burst of movement speed when hitting enemies with her Main Attack.

hypercharge.name: UNLIMITED ENERGY
hypercharge.description: Max throws an energy drink to each team member, increasing their movement speed and granting them 25% Super charge.
hypercharge.buffie_description: Max grants herself and nearby teammates 7% Super charge whenever she hits with her main attack.

recommended_build.note: A reliable mobility-and-pressure build. Super Charged is stronger when coordinated pushes can keep landing hits during the speed window.

16000032.source_note: Ability and Buffy text was checked against the current Brawl Stars Wiki; Gear progression and Buffy rules were cross-checked with Supercell. Verified 2026-08-31.

16000034.name: JACKY
16000034.intro: Jacky is a fast short-range tank whose circular attack hits instantly through walls. She uses cover and movement speed to enter range, then pulls enemies together with Holey Moley for uninterrupted area damage.

attack.name: Groundbreaker
attack.description: Jacky hops on her Jackhammer to shake the ground all around. Enemies caught too close will get a pounding!

super.name: Holey Moley!
super.description: Jacky drills a hole in the ground, pulling in foes to introduce them to her Jackhammer!

how_to_use: Use walls to approach because Groundbreaker damages enemies safely through them.
Activate Pneumatic Booster before crossing the final open distance or carrying the ball through pressure.
Pull multiple enemies only when ammo and teammates are ready to punish the group.
Use Rebuild to restore defensive cover or close a sightline that enemy marksmen opened.
Retreat after spending ammo; Jacky's reload is not fast enough to win every prolonged chase.
strengths: High health and fast movement
Instant circular damage through walls
Super interrupts and groups enemies
Strong corner and objective pressure
watch_out_for: Very short range
Knockbacks deny close pressure
Moderate reload creates downtime
Open maps expose the approach

gadgets.name: PNEUMATIC BOOSTER
gadgets.description: Jacky gets a burst of energy and moves 25% faster for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

gadgets.name: REBUILD
gadgets.description: Jacky rebuilds the environment in a small radius around her. Cooldown: 11 seconds.

star_powers.name: COUNTER CRUSH
star_powers.description: When receiving damage, Jacky returns the favor by converting 30% of the damage into a Groundbreaker counterattack.

star_powers.name: HARDY HARD HAT
star_powers.description: Jacky's Hard Hat protects her by reducing any damage she takes by 20%.

hypercharge.name: SEISMIC EVENT
hypercharge.description: Holey Moley slows down nearby enemies for 1.5 seconds.

recommended_build.note: A dependable approach-and-survive setup. Counter Crush gains value on enclosed maps where enemies must remain close.

16000034.source_note: Ability and Buffy text was checked against the current Brawl Stars Wiki; Gear progression and Buffy rules were cross-checked with Supercell. Verified 2026-08-31.

16000035.name: GALE
16000035.intro: Gale is a dependable controller with a wide long-range attack and exceptional knockback. He protects objectives and teammates by resetting enemy advances, blocking routes with Twister, and turning walls into stun opportunities.

attack.name: Polar Vortex
attack.description: Gale blasts a large snow ball wall at his enemies!

super.name: Gale Force!
super.description: Gale delivers an almighty gust of wind and snow, pushing back all enemies caught in its path.

how_to_use: Sweep the broad attack across bushes and multiple lanes instead of forcing every snowball onto one target.
Keep Gale Force ready when tanks or assassins need to cross a predictable approach.
Angle the Super toward a wall when using Blustery Blow so knockback converts into a stun.
Place Twister directly on a doorway, goal route, or jump landing to deny passage for its full duration.
Avoid pushing weak enemies to safety when teammates already have a guaranteed elimination.
strengths: Wide and consistent long-range pressure
Powerful team-protecting knockback
Twister can completely deny a route
Strong objective and anti-tank control
watch_out_for: Spread limits close maximum damage
Super may rescue an enemy if aimed poorly
Moderate finishing power
Open space reduces wall-stun value

gadgets.name: SPRING EJECTOR
gadgets.description: Gale drops a bounce pad underfoot, launching friend and foe alike into the air. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

gadgets.name: TWISTER
gadgets.description: Gale uses his leaf blower to create a local tornado, which will push away any opponents that try to pass through. Cooldown: 21 seconds.

star_powers.name: BLUSTERY BLOW
star_powers.description: Gale's Super now stuns enemies for 1.25 seconds if they are pushed against obstacles.

star_powers.name: FREEZING SNOW
star_powers.description: Gale's snow balls now also slow down opponents for 0.5 seconds.

hypercharge.name: BLIZZARD
hypercharge.description: Gale's Super is slightly wider and fires twice, pushing enemies even further away!

recommended_build.note: A hard-control setup for objectives and wall maps. Freezing Snow is the consistent option when wall stuns are unlikely.

16000035.source_note: Ability and Buffy text was checked against the current Brawl Stars Wiki; Gear progression and Buffy rules were cross-checked with Supercell. Verified 2026-08-31.

16000036.name: NANI
16000036.intro: Nani is a low-health marksman with one of the highest potential damage volleys in the game. Her three orbs follow a diamond path and reward precise convergence, while Peep delivers remote burst, knockback, and wall destruction from extreme range.

attack.name: Trigger-Nometry
attack.description: Nani shoots 3 light orbs that move at different angles and converge towards aimed targets.

super.name: Manual Override
super.description: Nani takes control of Peep and can steer him remotely into enemies, exploding on contact!

how_to_use: Drag the aim so all three orbs converge on the opponent rather than crossing too early or late.
Favor open sightlines where side orbs do not disappear into walls before convergence.
Launch Peep only from safe cover because Nani cannot move while steering it.
Use Return to Sender against a predictable high-damage projectile, not low-value chip.
Choose distant Peep routes with Autofocus, but retain enough steering control to guarantee contact.
strengths: Extremely high accurate-volley damage
Very long effective attack range
Peep threatens distant or hidden enemies
Super provides knockback and wall breaking
watch_out_for: Low health
Attack requires precise convergence
Stationary while steering Peep
Walls disrupt the side projectiles

gadgets.name: WARPIN' TIME
gadgets.description: Nani teleports to Peep's last known location and ends her Super. Cooldown: 13 seconds.

gadgets.name: RETURN TO SENDER
gadgets.description: For the next 2 seconds, the first time Nani takes damage from an enemy, 80% of the damage is returned to the enemy. Cooldown: 17 seconds.

star_powers.name: AUTOFOCUS
star_powers.description: Peep deals up to 2000 extra damage based on his travel distance.

star_powers.name: TEMPERED STEEL
star_powers.description: Nani takes 80% less damage while her Super is active.

hypercharge.name: BIG PEEP
hypercharge.description: Peep grows in size during travel.

recommended_build.note: A long-range burst build. Tempered Steel is safer when Nani cannot reliably launch Peep from protected cover.

16000036.source_note: Ability and Buffy text was checked against the current Brawl Stars Wiki; Gear progression and Buffy rules were cross-checked with Supercell. Verified 2026-08-31.

16000037.name: SPROUT
16000037.intro: Sprout is an artillery controller whose bouncing seed bombs reach behind walls and whose Hedge temporarily changes the map itself. Good wall placement can isolate enemies or seal an objective; careless placement can trap allies and waste their route.

attack.name: Seed Bomb
attack.description: Sprout propels a ball of seeds that bounces around before bursting with a bang! If it makes contact with enemies, it explodes on impact.

super.name: Hedge
super.description: Sprout uses its Super Seed to grow a thick vine hedge, creating an impassable though temporary obstacle.

how_to_use: Bounce Seed Bombs from walls to extend reach and make the landing angle harder to read.
Use attacks to deny exits rather than chasing direct hits against fast enemies.
Connect Hedge to permanent terrain so a small placement blocks a much larger route.
Check teammate positions before creating a wall; an ally trapped on the wrong side loses the fight.
Use Transplant when an old wall no longer matters and a new barrier can decide the next engagement.
strengths: Safe artillery pressure over walls
Bounces extend attack routes
Super can reshape paths and objectives
Strong choke-point and escape denial
watch_out_for: Moderately low health
Divers can reach Sprout behind cover
Poor hedges obstruct teammates
Open maps reduce bounce and wall value

gadgets.name: GARDEN MULCHER
gadgets.description: Sprout consumes a bush to restore 1920 health. Cooldown: 9 seconds.

gadgets.name: TRANSPLANT
gadgets.description: Sprout destroys its current Hedge, but will instantly have its Super fully charged again. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

star_powers.name: OVERGROWTH
star_powers.description: Every 5 seconds, the next Seed Bomb will explode with a larger explosion radius.

star_powers.name: PHOTOSYNTHESIS
star_powers.description: Sprout activates a shield, partially protecting itself from all attacks while inside a bush.

hypercharge.name: THORNS
hypercharge.description: Sprout's vine hedge now damages nearby enemies.

recommended_build.note: A flexible control setup with reliable explosions and repeat wall placement. Photosynthesis plus Garden Mulcher suits bush-heavy survival maps.

16000037.source_note: Ability and Buffy text was checked against the current Brawl Stars Wiki; Gear progression and Buffy rules were cross-checked with Supercell. Verified 2026-08-31.

16000039.name: COLETTE
16000039.intro: Colette is a specialist damage dealer whose main attack scales with the target's current health and whose dash scales with maximum health. She removes large portions of tank health quickly, then relies on fixed minimum damage, teammates, or a second Super hit to finish.

attack.name: Taxing Shot
attack.description: Colette fires a shot that takes what you owe! And the more you have, the more you owe.

super.name: Time To Collect
super.description: Colette makes a dash forth and back, dealing taxing damage to everyone in her path, based on their maximum health.

how_to_use: Open on the healthiest target; Taxing Shot gains the most value before teammates lower that health.
Track the minimum-damage transition and let a teammate or Gadget secure low-health finishes.
Aim Time To Collect through multiple enemies only when the return route also remains clear.
Use walls carefully because touching one forces an early turn and may lose the second pass.
Activate Gotcha! against a high-health enemy to convert large percentage damage into meaningful healing.
strengths: Excellent percentage damage against tanks
Super can hit twice and cross water
Strong fixed damage against special targets
Long range and reliable projectile speed
watch_out_for: Consecutive attacks lose damage as health falls
Needs help finishing low-health enemies
Walls shorten or disrupt the Super
Dash path can become predictable

gadgets.name: NA-AH!
gadgets.description: Colette fires a projectile that charms a Brawler for 0.5 sec. Uses ammo. Cooldown: 22 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: The projectile pierces environments and Brawlers.

gadgets.name: GOTCHA!
gadgets.description: Colette fires a projectile that heals for 80% of damage done. Uses ammo and can be fired up to 3 times before cooldown. Cooldown: 17 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Can overheal, creating a shield of 1000 maximum health.

star_powers.name: PUSH IT
star_powers.description: All enemy Brawlers hit by Colette's charge are carried to the farthest point of the attack! At max distance, they are stunned for 0.2 sec.
star_powers.buffie_description: Super dash speed is significantly faster.

star_powers.name: MASS TAX
star_powers.description: Colette takes 60% less damage during her Super and gains a 30% shield for 3 sec if she hits a Brawler.
star_powers.buffie_description: Colette steals 33% ammo of any Brawlers she hits.

hypercharge.name: TEEN SPIRIT
hypercharge.description: Colette's spirit follows her during her dash, damaging enemies on the way.
hypercharge.buffie_description: Colette follows up each main attack with a smaller second attack that deals less damage.

recommended_build.note: A reliable duel-and-conversion build. Mass Tax is stronger when the Super must cross concentrated enemy fire or multiple targets.

16000039.source_note: Ability and Buffy text was checked against the current Brawl Stars Wiki; Gear progression and Buffy rules were cross-checked with Supercell. Verified 2026-08-31.

16000040.name: AMBER
16000040.intro: Amber is a sustained-fire controller with one large continuous ammo bar. She tracks movement with a stream of piercing flames and stores flammable oil on the map, forcing enemies to respect both current fire and a future ignition threat.

attack.name: Dragon's Breath
attack.description: Amber blows a flaming inferno at her opponents. It looks awesome, but watch out or you'll get seared!

super.name: Torch 'Em!
super.description: Amber throws a flask of her fire fluid that she can then light up with her firebreathing. Bushes and opposing Brawlers will be toast! (One flask at a time!)

how_to_use: Fire in controlled bursts so Amber retains enough fuel to punish a sudden push.
Sweep through grouped enemies because flames pierce and reward accurate tracking.
Leave oil unlit while its threat controls a route; ignite only when an enemy commits or bushes must be removed.
Stand near oil with the relevant Star Power to gain Super charge or faster reload without wasting the puddle.
Use Dancing Flames against close pressure or stationary targets that can be struck by the orbit.
strengths: High sustained piercing damage
Continuous attack is easy to adjust while firing
Oil creates lasting route pressure
Strong bush destruction and objective control
watch_out_for: Full fuel takes a long time to restore
Low burst if caught with an empty bar
Premature ignition wastes map control
Fast flankers can escape the tracking stream

gadgets.name: FIRE STARTERS
gadgets.description: Amber runs fast for 3 seconds while spilling her fire fluid, which she can then ignite. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Amber can place up to 2 barrels.

gadgets.name: DANCING FLAMES
gadgets.description: Amber creates 3 orbiting flames around her for 5 seconds, dealing 1890 damage on hit. Cooldown: 14 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Amber gains 20% movement speed and deals 400 damage to enemies she touches.

star_powers.name: WILD FLAMES
star_powers.description: Amber can have two fuel puddles on the ground simultaneously and she will recharge her Super automatically when standing near one.
star_powers.buffie_description: Amber gains 10% movement speed when near oil.

star_powers.name: SCORCHIN' SIPHON
star_powers.description: While being near a puddle of fire fluid, Amber uses it to reload her firebreathing 50% faster.
star_powers.buffie_description: Burn duration is increased by 1 second.

hypercharge.name: OIL SPILL
hypercharge.description: Super's oil spill area is increased. Oil keeps burning for 3 seconds after being lit on fire.
hypercharge.buffie_description: Main attacks also burn like oil.

recommended_build.note: A broad control setup with anti-close pressure and multiple slowing oil zones. Scorchin' Siphon excels when a protected puddle can support sustained firing.

16000040.source_note: Ability and Buffy text was checked against the current Brawl Stars Wiki; Gear progression and Buffy rules were cross-checked with Supercell. Verified 2026-08-31.

16000041.name: LOU
16000041.intro: Lou is a long-range controller who builds Frost with every snow cone until enemies become stunned. His icy Super makes movement unreliable, prevents healing, and steadily increases Frost, making objectives dangerous to occupy.

attack.name: Brain Freeze
attack.description: Barraging opponents with snow cones, Lou can eventually freeze them in place for 1.5 seconds.

super.name: Can-Do
super.description: Lou lobs a can of freezing cold syrup that creates an icy, slippery area on the ground that also slowly freezes and damages enemies. Very tough for his opponents' fancy footwork!

how_to_use: Track one target long enough to complete the Frost meter instead of spreading every burst across the team.
Lead the narrow three-cone burst so multiple projectiles connect as the enemy moves.
Cover the objective or a forced turn with Can-Do; slippery movement is strongest where opponents cannot run straight.
Use Cryo Syrup only when important enemies are already inside the Super and the added Frost creates a stun threat.
Save Ice Block for a predictable burst, delayed explosion, or final objective second.
strengths: Repeated hits create a full stun
Very long range and fast reload
Super controls objectives for ten seconds
Frost can reduce enemy damage with loadout
watch_out_for: Narrow burst demands tracking accuracy
Frost decays when pressure stops
Low per-projectile damage
Ice Block prevents Lou from moving or attacking

gadgets.name: ICE BLOCK
gadgets.description: Lou shields himself with ice, becoming invulnerable for 1 seconds. Cooldown: 18 seconds.

gadgets.name: CRYO SYRUP
gadgets.description: Instantly adds 50% freeze meter to opponents inside Lou's Super. Cooldown: 18 seconds.

star_powers.name: SUPERCOOL
star_powers.description: Opponents standing on Lou's Super area get frozen 14% faster.

star_powers.name: HYPOTHERMIA
star_powers.description: Opponents lose up to 50% of their damage based on how frozen they are from Lou's attacks.

hypercharge.name: SLUSHIE STORM
hypercharge.description: Lou's Super instantly freezes enemies in the area.

recommended_build.note: An objective-freeze setup that accelerates stuns. Ice Block and Hypothermia provide the safer alternative against high burst.

16000041.source_note: Ability and Buffy text was checked against the current Brawl Stars Wiki; Gear progression and Buffy rules were cross-checked with Supercell. Verified 2026-08-31.

16000038.name: SURGE
16000038.intro: Surge is an upgrade-focused damage dealer who becomes more threatening each time he cycles his Super. His early goal is to earn the first stage safely; after that, his speed, range, and projectile pressure let him take control of lanes.

attack.name: Juice of Justice
attack.description: Surge serves a shot of Juice that splits in two on contact with enemies.

super.name: Party Tricks
super.description: With each Super, Surge gets upgraded (MAX 3). Upgrades are lost when Surge is defeated.STAGE 1: Boosted movement speedSTAGE 2: Increased weapon rangeSTAGE 3: Main attack splits into 6 (instead of 2)

how_to_use: Play patiently at Stage 1; building your first Super is your absolute top priority.
Use Party Tricks defensively to jump over incoming attacks and knock back diving tanks.
Once at Stage 3, shoot through targets to let the 6-way split pressure enemies behind them.
Use Power Shield to absorb high-impact projectiles and instantly reload 3 ammo.
Use Serve Ice Cold in 3v3 modes to keep Stage 1 upgrades after respawning.
strengths: Becomes immensely powerful as upgrade stages increase
Super provides invulnerability jump and knockback
Stage 3 split attacks dominate grouped teams
Strong counter to tanks and close-range assassins
watch_out_for: Very weak and slow at Stage 1 before upgrading
Losing upgrades on death resets momentum
Slow reload speed punishes missed shots
Out-ranged by snipers in the early game

gadgets.name: POWER SURGE
gadgets.description: Surge's power surges! Increase Super charge rate by 30% for 5 sec. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Power Surge also grants 30% Reload Speed.

gadgets.name: POWER SHIELD
gadgets.description: Within the next 2 seconds, Surge consumes 50% of the damage of the next incoming hit and uses the energy to reload 1 ammo. Cooldown: 22 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: If Surge is hit during Power Shield, Gadget cooldown is decreased by 50%.

star_powers.name: TO THE MAX!
star_powers.description: Surge's Main Attack now bounces off walls.
star_powers.buffie_description: When bouncing off a wall, Surge's Main Attack splits into 2 extra projectiles.

star_powers.name: SERVE ICE COLD
star_powers.description: Surge always spawns with a full Super Charge.
star_powers.buffie_description: While in Stage 3, Surge gains a burst of movement speed when using his Super.

hypercharge.name: STAGE 5
hypercharge.description: Surge's Super gains increased ranged and shoots Justice Juice in every direction when landing!
hypercharge.buffie_description: Surge shoots 'Double the Juice' for Double the Justice.

recommended_build.note: Serve Ice Cold is essential in 3v3 modes to maintain movement speed upon respawn. Power Shield counters burst brawlers.

16000038.source_note: Ability and Buffy text was checked against the current Brawl Stars Wiki; Gear progression and Buffy rules were cross-checked with Supercell. Verified 2026-08-31.

16000000.name: SHELLY
16000000.intro: Shelly is a versatile frontline damage dealer whose buckshot spread covers wide angles at mid-range and deals devastating burst up close. Her Super destroys cover, pushes enemies back, and can chain rapidly against close-range opponents.

attack.name: Buckshot
attack.description: Shelly's boomstick fires a wide spread of pellets to a medium range. The more pellets hit, the greater the damage.

super.name: Super Shell
super.description: Shelly's Super Shell obliterates both cover and enemies. Any survivors get knocked back.

how_to_use: Use bushes and wall corners to close distance so you can land full-damage point-blank bursts.
Save Super Shell for close-range ambushes or to cancel enemy Supers like Frank, Carl, or Bibi.
Chain Supers by firing Super Shell at point-blank range followed immediately by a normal attack.
Use Clay Pigeons to surprise retreating low-health enemies at sniper ranges.
Use Shell Shock when playing in team modes to slow enemies for your teammates to secure easy eliminations.
strengths: Devastating point-blank burst damage
Super can chain repeatedly and break walls
Cancels enemy abilities and channelled Supers
Clay Pigeons provides flexible long-range threat
watch_out_for: Struggles on open maps without cover
Pellet spread loses heavy damage at long distance
Outranged by snipers and throwers
Vulnerable when reloading after a failed rush

gadgets.name: FAST FORWARD
gadgets.description: Shelly dashes to an aimed direction or forwards, fully reloading her ammo! Cooldown: 16 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Take no damage while dashing.

gadgets.name: CLAY PIGEONS
gadgets.description: Shelly focuses her fire to a smaller area with an increased range. Can be used 3 times per activation. Cooldown: 18 seconds.
gadgets.buffie_description: Attacks slow enemies. Increases duration with each hit.

16000108.name: WENDY
16000108.intro: Wendy is a Legendary support brawler whose attack damages enemies while shielding herself, or shields a teammate on hit. Planet Protector deploys a generator that absorbs most damage taken by allies inside its area.

attack.name: Blow Dryer
attack.description: Wendy fires a blast dealing 2000 damage and giving herself 1160 shield. When hitting a teammate, Wendy gives them 1520 shield.

super.name: Planet Protector
super.description: Wendy deploys a shield generator that absorbs 75% of damage taken by Wendy and her teammates within its range.

how_to_use: Aim Blow Dryer through teammates when possible so the same attack contributes useful shielding instead of only damage.
Place Planet Protector where teammates can stay inside its area without exposing the generator to easy focus fire.
Use Wind-Powered to jump out of danger or cross a short obstacle when enemies collapse on the generator.
Use Green Grenade to slow enemies and briefly stop their healing during a coordinated push.
Keep enough distance to preserve Wendy's own attack shields before committing to a sustained fight.
strengths: Attacks can damage enemies or shield teammates
Planet Protector reduces incoming damage for allies in its area
Green Grenade combines a slow with temporary healing denial
Wind-Powered provides short emergency mobility
watch_out_for: Planet Protector loses value if enemies can quickly destroy or zone its generator
Missing teammates with Blow Dryer sacrifices an important source of allied shielding
Wendy's support value depends on teammates staying near the generator at the right time
Divers can force Wendy away from the area she is trying to protect
